title: Launch Claude Smoke Test
tagline: One short recorded session, replayed on both engines, to prove the measuring chain works end to end.

notice.label: Smoke test.
notice.text: These numbers come from one 6-turn toy session (a one-line bug fix), recorded once and replayed on each engine to check that recording, replay and this page work together. They are not a benchmark result. Every cell not measured here says why. The real results go on the main leaderboard.
